notes:
No input study identifiers, neutral description or effect locators were supplied. The linked primary replication report identifies one focal claim, H4, so replication values refer to that claim. Standardized beta is printed; the same passage also prints unstandardized b = 0.164. Requested es_type ser_method supplies no named metric. The report quotes original beta = .34 and p < .01, but original-side values remain null because original full text was unavailable and the quotation was not independently verified. Original title verified using OpenAlex and DOI metadata. Acquisition routes: DOI landing page redirected to Elsevier; ScienceDirect returned 403 and was not retried; Unpaywall had no OA locations; OpenAlex indicated closed with no repository full text; Europe PMC returned zero DOI matches; title/DOI open-access searches found metadata and unrelated citing papers only. Replication file API verified report name and project 7k8sy; downloaded full PDF and parsed text. Authors note reduced sample relative to the preregistered target and caution on power; this does not replace their explicit successful-replication verdict.
Source follow-up: Primary source is available. A unique target test cannot be selected from the neutral input. Published article copy from private Google Drive archive; Crossref independently matches requested DOI, title and authors; title coverage in first3PDFpages=1.0, author surnames found=Popper,Amit.
